performanceHelp: Lower shadows and resolution for smoother interaction.

invalidBrand: Check the brand name, folder name, colors, and logo.
pinNotice: The PIN is a demo convenience, not secure authentication.

updateWhenReady: Finish the current action before updating.
contextLostMessage: The 3D view paused. Your design is kept. Restore the view to continue.

inspectHint: Look at the selected unit up close. Press again to go back.
unitsUnchanged: All units stay as they are.
layoutNeedsRoom: {layout} needs a larger room, so the room is now {size}.
layoutChanged: Layout changed to {layout}, with your colours.

roomTooSmallWardrobe: Too small for this wardrobe. Smallest size: {size}.
